verdict.rationale: PostHog publishes a live OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json, OAuth on its hosted MCP server with 150 granular read/write resource scopes, and an MCP catalog of 953 tools across 65 product categories that it says spans 'every PostHog product'. The CLI wraps the same API and tool catalog, and the documented SQL query endpoint plus scoped personal API keys give broad programmatic coverage of what the UI does. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party guarantee of full UI/API parity, independent hands-on corroboration that UI-only actions (e.g. no-code workflow building) are fully API-equivalent, and the /query endpoint's documented limits (not an export mechanism, no OFFSET pagination for API keys).
